reason: I pay for nothing right now. I get placement prep free from YouTube and GeeksforGeeks and ask doubts to a free chatbot, and this asks me to start paying for the same kind of help. The free tier also gives me a resume score, which I can get elsewhere for nothing.
objection: I can't see what this gives me that free YouTube, GeeksforGeeks and free ATS checkers don't, so I'd be paying for the same thing in a different wrapper.
would_change_my_mind: If the hidden-test code checking, which the page says is coming later, were already live and clearly caught mistakes my free practice misses.
